item_2_new_play_magnitude_block_gap_owne.action: ADD new play magnitude.block_gap_ownership (supersedes NOTHING yet - magnitude.weekend_gap_delivery remains the blind-node incumbent through G13 probation; on forward evidence this play ABSORBS weekend_gap_delivery's arms as its weather branch and the incumbent retires to cautionary/watch status per supersession doctrine)
item_2_new_play_magnitude_block_gap_owne.trigger: every Friday close going into a Sunday/holiday reopen, and every block-opening gap
item_2_new_play_magnitude_block_gap_owne.read: OWNERSHIP DECISION at the prior close, strict order: (1) ANCHOR_STRUCTURAL - is a structural driver live? (squeeze building; squeeze sponsor DEAD with premium still in the front; armed parabolic crest) -> the gap belongs to the structural resolution: sign = the resolution direction, band -1500..-2500 with a DECLARED tail to -7000+ when the premium is large (measure it: front-next spread displacement + the final squeeze-tail day's net). (2) WEEKEND_CYCLE_WEATHER - no structural driver: the weekend model cycle's fresh-vs-priced arms (the incumbent weekend_gap_delivery bands: fresh +1500..+2500, priced +200..+400). (3) CHAIN_DRIFT - no structural driver, no fresh weather: prior close AT its chain-side extreme -> the weekend delivers a chain-session continuation, band -600..-1600 at chain sign (n=2 THIN: 1130 -590 delivered as the Sunday session, 0208 -1550 as the gap; flagged).
item_2_new_play_magnitude_block_gap_owne.mechanism: A squeeze/parabolic premium is carried by a FLOW (delivery covering, trapped shorts), not by a stock of information. When the flow's sponsor dies (prompt expiry, covering complete), the premium decays at the first long liquidity gap - the weekend is the longest gap on the calendar, so the repricing concentrates there. Weather gaps, by contrast, are information-stock repricings and scale with the weekend cycle's delta. That is why the same feed that correctly read 'no weather change' on 0201 coexisted with the walk's largest gap.
item_2_new_play_magnitude_block_gap_owne.evidence_n: structural n=3 spanning G9/G11/G12 (1207 -2380, 0125 +2480, 0201 -7080); weather-fresh n=2 spanning G5/G11 (1019, 0118); priced n=2 spanning G8/G10 (1124, 0111); chain-drift n=2 THIN spanning G8/G12 (1130, 0208).

item_3_flip_gap_as_counter_addendum.text: BLOCK-OPENING GAP AS ARM-COMPLETING COUNTER DELIVERY: when the parabolic ARM is satisfied on run metrics but the final extension day closed AT its extreme (no >=30%-off blow-off close - the E1/0201 situation), a weekend/block-opening gap AGAINST the chain whose DAY MOVE (gap + session net) breaks the condition-class counter band >=~1.5x supplies BOTH the missing blow-off AND C1. Mechanism: a squeeze-tail's blow-off can occur OFF-SESSION - the marginal buyer (delivery covering) simply vanishes rather than selling into the close, so the roll-over that 1007/1205 printed intraday prints as the reopen gap instead. C2 on a thin Sunday tape (0201: 5 legs) is DIRECTIONAL ONLY - up-continuation 0/2, big up 0/1 collapsed, but the denominator is empty; corroborate on the next full session (0202: up-continuation 7/52 = 13%, big up 5/14 not majority -> clean). C4 may still pend to the arbiter without suspending the confirm (the 1205->1207/1208 precedent).

item_4_storage_thursday_spent_chain_scop.scoping: The chain-sided rule is CHAIN-STATE-scoped, not polarity-scoped and not print-sign-scoped: it holds while the chain is LIVE (young, or unwinding with its polarity's driver still delivering - G9's 1211/1218/1224 bullish draws SOLD inside the live down-crash even as the surplus narrowed all December, which kills the naive 'narrowing surplus -> with-print' story). A disagreeing print trades WITH its sign when the chain is SPENT: price at/past its retrace target, the chain's driver expired, basing rhythm in force (0129: bleed-end at the walk's lows; 0205/0212: basing at the pre-squeeze shelf after a completed unwind). With-print days at a spent chain are IN-BAND counter days (+1480 max, then +540, +120 - never band-breaking) and are FLIP-CHECKLIST WATCH INPUTS (the 0129->0130 sequence ended the last down-regime), never flips by themselves.

item_8_scoring_convention_block_opening_.action: ADD to doctrine_tier3.scoring_split - GAP OWNERSHIP SCORING (Greg's order, part c)
item_8_scoring_convention_block_opening_.rule: Gap and net remain separately scored events; what changes is that OWNERSHIP is explicit and the reporting cannot hide one behind the other. (1) DECLARE: every forecast of a block-opening or Sunday reopen gap must carry gap_owner in {anchor_structural, weekend_cycle_weather, chain_drift} declared AT THE ANCHOR/prior close, plus the band class used. (2) SCORE: the scorecard's day row carries gap_dir_ok AND gap_class_ok (realized gap inside the declared band, tail declared = miss with named tail) at EQUAL RANK with net_dir_ok; reopen days additionally carry day_move_dir_ok (sign of gap+net) - the headline hit/miss for a reopen day is the day_move composite, so 0201 reads MISS (+150g vs -7590a day move) with the net sub-score a hit, never the reverse. (3) ATTRIBUTE: when the realized gap's driver class differs from the declared owner, the OWNERSHIP call is scored as the miss (a new ownership_ok flag) - that is the exact error 0201 exposes (blind declared weather-priced; the driver was structural). (4) DRIFT attribution names gap residual separately from net residual per day, as g12_score already does numerically - the change is the headline convention.
item_8_scoring_convention_block_opening_.g13_0215_procedure: At the 0213 anchor (close 3.084 on instrument 996/April): FIRST declare the 0215 gap owner. Structural check: March (NGH26) expiry Feb 25 falls INSIDE G13 and squeeze_watch's day-count is <=7 from 0213 - read the March-April spread's level and 3d change at the anchor (0212 vintage: +0.137): positive-AND-widening -> anchor_structural owner, squeeze doctrine (bands void on the squeeze leg; the walk instrument is April, once-removed - the G12 handoff note stands); flat/narrowing (the G12-observed state: collapsed from +0.336 to ~+0.09-0.16 post-unwind) -> no structural owner. THEN the weekend cycle: fresh/accelerating shot at D+2..D+6 -> weather owner with the fresh band at the shot's sign; nothing fresh -> chain_drift owner: 0213 closed -160 mid-range (NOT at a chain extreme), so the drift band is the priced stub +-200..400 at chain sign, NOT the -600..-1600 continuation class (that class requires a prior close AT its extreme). Score 0215 per (2)-(3): gap_dir, gap_class, ownership, then the Sunday session net as its own event, then day_move composite as the headline.
item_8_scoring_convention_block_opening_.note: Presidents Day 0216 follows the 0215 Sunday - the Monday-reaction arm and thin-holiday flags apply downstream; they are unchanged by this item.

item_9_squeeze_watch_definition_fix.action: STATE/BUILD item - squeeze_watch keys on the wrong contract
item_9_squeeze_watch_definition_fix.finding: The Jan/Feb squeeze lived in the EXPIRING PROMPT (NGG26, expiry Jan 28, ran to 7.460) while squeeze_watch counts days_to_calendar_front_expiry on the CALENDAR FRONT the walk trades (March: 17 days at the anchor) - so the watch was structurally blind to the squeeze it was built for, and equally blind to the UNWIND trigger (prompt expiry passing while the front still carries premium).
item_9_squeeze_watch_definition_fix.fix: Add prompt-month fields to contract_structure (prompt_symbol, prompt_expiry, days_to_prompt_expiry, prompt_settle, prompt_front_spread) and give squeeze_watch a second arm: DEAD-SPONSOR UNWIND WATCH = prompt expiry has passed within ~3 sessions AND the front-next spread is >= ~2x its 20d norm (premium stranded) -> the next long liquidity gap is the unwind window (item 2's structural owner). Back-test on G11/G12 vintages before G13 if feasible; otherwise flag as the standing missing state variable it already was in s100_2_irreducibles(d).
item_9_squeeze_watch_definition_fix.forward_evidence: n=1 (0201) for the unwind arm; the build is justified by the walk's largest gap.
